'''''Star Maps and Scripts: The Rakata Connection''''' was a thesis that was co-written by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Henrietya Antilles]] and [[Gideon Na'al]]. It focused on how archaeological discoveries showed how contemporary [[Writing/Legends|writing systems]] had been influenced by those used by the extinct [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] species.
